hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && W=$(node -p "require('./package.json').devDependencies.playwright" 2>/dev/null); H=$(node -p "require('./node_modules/playwright/package.json').version" 2>/dev/null); if [ "$W" != "$H" ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "GLASS ERP: npm ci done, playwright $W"; fi; exit 0
